verdict.reason: Almagreira is worth a quick check for mid-morning — 11:00, but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  Wind is the main thing to watch.  The tide is part of the picture, but not the deciding factor.

conversationalSummary.text: TODAY I’d check the cameras first before committing: Almagreira mid-morning around 11:00 is the best available option, but Surfline is only poor-to-fair and the wind angle isn’t great for that spot. The tide is near high and falling, so it might stay workable for an exposed north-coast beach break, but the wind could make it messy quickly. Give Surfline and the MEO Beachcam a look and only leave if it looks notably better than you’d expect—otherwise I’d save the drive.
